Generic Biotech Holdings, Inc. Provides Regulatory and Clinical Program Update

Generic Biotech Holdings, Inc. (the "Company") today announced an update regarding its ongoing engagement with the applicable regulatory authority for its lead clinical program, GBH-101. Following a recent meeting, the regulatory authority indicated that it did not consider the Company's proposed primary endpoint appropriate to establish the effectiveness of the therapy for the target indication. As a result, the Company states that the ongoing study can no longer be characterized as pivotal or registrational until the primary endpoint is revised in further discussion with the regulatory authority.

The Company intends to submit a revised clinical development plan and will provide further updates as they become available.
